label: PF Backlog 411
title: PIDL-5: approval-policy integration + outcome/correction feedback + versioned traceability + API/UI
body: Doc docs/PF-Backlog-SSOT-Scheduler-Pluggable-Workers-updated.md PIDL 'approval', 'versioning', 'implementation order' #9-11. Centralized approval-policy integration (auto within limits -> human approval beyond), feedback that does NOT auto-promote corrections to rules, per-decision traceability (task/revision/worker/profile_version/rules/evidence), and UI/API visibility of decision/evidence/confidence/approval.
